prompt: The CSV parser in src/parse-csv.js does not follow RFC 4180. Quoted fields are not handled: a field wrapped in double quotes may contain commas, newlines, and escaped double quotes ("" for a literal quote), and the surrounding quotes must be stripped from the parsed value. Fix the parser so quoted fields parse correctly, and keep all existing unquoted behaviour working. Run `node test/parse-csv.test.js` to check your work.
success_criteria: Quoted fields containing commas parse as a single field
Quoted fields containing newlines parse as a single field
Escaped double quotes inside a quoted field decode to one literal quote
Surrounding quotes are stripped from the parsed value
Existing unquoted parsing behaviour is unchanged
